lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are organized into distinct vertical columns posterior to the fifth gill slit. The spatial density of these centroids decreases posteriorly, transitioning from tightly packed clusters to a structured grid on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the column-based blobs, forming a series of anchor nodes where vertical and horizontal luminance gradients intersect across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a high-contrast vertical gradient (specular highlight on the superior edge, shadow on the inferior edge).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small white notch or depigmented area is visible on the distal trailing edge of the right pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a symbiotic teleost (remora) positioned ventrally beneath the pectoral fin silhouette.
